is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus mosquitoes (Abstract, page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for kdr-East (L1014F), kdr-West (L1014S), Ace-1 (G119S), and GSTe2 (L114T) (Page 4, 7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper reports the number of samples genotyped (n=134) and the prevalence/counts for kdr-e (94.7%, n=58) and kdr-w (60%, n=10) (Page 7).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from three sub-counties in Busia County, Kenya (Page 1, 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study involving field collection and molecular analysis of mosquitoes (Page 3-4).

sub_country_location.evidence: The study specifies collection sites in three sub-counties: Budalangi, Butula, and Teso South (Page 3).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito collection was carried out in June 2023 (Page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new field collection in June 2023.

supplement.evidence: The required genotype data is provided in the main text (Page 7).

assessment.summary: This study investigated Microsporidia MB prevalence and insecticide resistance markers in Anopheles mosquitoes from Busia, Kenya. It reports high frequencies of kdr-East and kdr-West mutations in a subset of 134 genotyped mosquitoes.
